flags.purpose: Retrieves processes by executable name to identify running applications and system processes.
flags.security_use_case: Quickly locate specific processes by name during triage or monitoring.
flags.threat_detected: Processes matching known malware names or unwanted applications.
flags.risk_if_misused: None; read-only. Names can be spoofed by malware.
flags.safe_followup: Check Path and hash with Get-FileHash; verify protections with Get-ProcessMitigation.

flags.purpose: Retrieves detailed module and version information for a specific PID.
flags.security_use_case: Detect DLL injection and suspicious modules in a target process.
flags.threat_detected: Unsigned or unexpected DLLs loaded into legitimate processes.
flags.risk_if_misused: None; read-only. Snapshot may miss transient modules.
flags.safe_followup: Validate signatures with Get-AuthenticodeSignature; compare against baseline.

flags.purpose: Lists DLL modules loaded into a process with paths.
flags.security_use_case: Identify module injection or DLL hijacking.
flags.threat_detected: Unknown DLLs inside critical processes like svchost or explorer.
flags.risk_if_misused: None; read-only. Advanced malware may hide modules.
flags.safe_followup: Check file existence, path legitimacy, and signatures.

flags.purpose: Shows embedded version metadata of executables.
flags.security_use_case: Detect masquerading malware with mismatched metadata.
flags.threat_detected: Fake system binary names with inconsistent version/company fields.
flags.risk_if_misused: None; read-only. Metadata can be forged.
flags.safe_followup: Cross-check with known-good copies and digital signatures.

flags.purpose: Shows which user account owns each process.
flags.security_use_case: Find processes running under unexpected or privileged accounts.
flags.threat_detected: Malware executing under Administrator or SYSTEM contexts.
flags.risk_if_misused: Requires admin privileges; otherwise access denied.
flags.safe_followup: Investigate why privileged accounts run user apps; consider Stop-Process if malicious.

flags.purpose: Remotely queries processes on another host via PowerShell remoting.
flags.risk_if_misused: Needs permissions and remoting enabled; sensitive in production.
flags.safe_followup: Use Invoke-Command for controlled remote inspection or remediation.

powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Finds privileged processes running from non-standard paths.
powerful_combinations.security_context: Detects elevated malware outside expected system directories.

powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Highlights modules loaded from outside Windows directories.
powerful_combinations.security_context: Reveals injected or third-party code in processes.

powerful_combinations.command: Get-Process | ForEach-Object { try { $_.MainModule.FileName } catch {} } | Where-Object {$_ -notmatch 'C:\\Windows'} | Get-Item | Select FullName,Length,LastWriteTime,@{N='SHA256';E={(Get-FileHash $_.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash}}
powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Builds a hashed inventory of non-system executables currently running.
powerful_combinations.security_context: Supports malware hunting and threat intel correlation using hashes.
